challengeDescription: Build an AI-powered solution that addresses a meaningful environmental or societal challenge. Solutions may focus on improving resource efficiency, increasing accessibility, strengthening resilience, supporting communities, or enabling more informed and sustainable decision-making.
projectProblemStatement: Residents struggle to turn everyday civic problems into clear, actionable reports and to track whether a fix actually happened. Namma Civic connects accessible local reporting, community discussion, evidence-backed responses and citizen verification in one public record.
